a.name: Docket
a.description: The figures as an itemised bill: label, dotted leader, right-set figure, three ruled columns under a steel top rule.
a.differs_from: Leader lines in a ruled docket, not tiles: no built strip pairs label and figure along a dotted leader, and none is framed by rules alone.

b.name: Figure sentence
b.description: The figures set inside one spoken sentence beside a litter photo, each raised on a steel-100 highlight; bleed bed under a steel rule.
b.differs_from: The only counter strip with a photo, and the figures live inside a sentence instead of tiles, cells or columns; every built strip is photo-free tiles.

c.name: Price scale
c.description: Figures as stops on one broken number line, delivery to deposit to price; vertical on phones, inset on a steel-100 panel.
c.differs_from: A number line that orders the figures by what you pay, not a row of cells; no built strip draws an axis, and none sits in an inset panel.
